body.description: Vertical addition to an existing two-story, four-unit building. Addition of a new dwelling unit.
Interior remodel and layout change to the kitchen and bathroom.
The project proposes repairs to the existing second floor rear deck and replacement of the rear stairs with a spiral stair.

Response to NOV 202657146 related to an unapproved handrail. This submittal is to legalize the unapproved handrail at the front, exterior entry stairway. No expansion or changes to the building envelope are proposed.
The proposal is to demolish and reconstruct the existing deck and stair at the rear first and second story in-kind.

The scope of work will abate work performed without a building permit per Enforcement Case No. 2017-016432ENF. Work will include replacement of a portion of the existing roof deck with a low slope roof, removal of windscreen walls, legalization of a portion of the roof deck, and installation of 42-inch-tall guardrails.
Certificate of Appropriateness for new dormer at gable roof at rear of property with one new window facing the rear yard.  New handrail at front stair.

The current basement level is to be lowered by 2'-4.5" to accommodate a garage and areas with ceiling heights of min 7'-6". A ramp to the garage flanked by planters and steps will replace the current front yard raised planter area. The rear of the house is to be remodeled with a new attached garden room at the North portion of the rear which replaces the current attached garden room located at the center of the rear.  New windows at the rear facade are also planned. Interior remodel as shown on drawing set on all levels. We understand a Certificate of Appropriateness is required for the garage level work but not the rear garden room or windows as confirmed by SF Planning.
Proposed balustrade work to replace entry non-original railing with a railing that matches the original character.
